Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog:
Spotify Mode now shows song title/artist automatically, no login required
Added a per-deck Autoplay toggle next to Jump to Cue
Added a Remove Sound Effect option to sound pads
